name: ashby_statement_pick_any_employer
label: Which of the following best describes your work authorization status?
options: Yes, I am authorized to work for my present employer only
Yes, I am authorized to work in this country for any employer
I require sponsorship to work in the United States
No, I am not authorized to work in this country
expect: Yes, I am authorized to work in this country for any employer
spec_quote: the engine picks the unrestricted authorized statement, e.g. "Yes, I am authorized to work in this country for any employer"

name: workday_statement_pick_any_employer
label: Please select the statement that applies to you:
options: I am legally authorized to work for any employer in the United States
I am authorized to work for a specific employer only
I will require sponsorship to work in the United States
I am not authorized to work in the United States
expect: I am legally authorized to work for any employer in the United States
spec_quote: the engine picks the unrestricted authorized statement, e.g. ... "I am legally authorized to work for any employer in the United States"

name: lever_yes_without_restrictions
label: Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?
spec_quote: the engine picks the unrestricted authorized statement, e.g. ... "Yes, without restrictions". A "Yes, with restrictions" ... statement is picked only when no plain or unrestricted Yes statement is offered.

name: icims_restricted_only_when_no_plain_yes
label: Do you have the legal right to work in the United States?
options: Yes, I am authorized to work with restrictions
expect: Yes, I am authorized to work with restrictions
spec_quote: A "Yes, with restrictions" / "authorized for my present employer only" / "I require sponsorship" statement is picked only when no plain or unrestricted Yes statement is offered. A statement that he is NOT authorized is never picked.

name: restricted_vs_sponsorship_only_options
label: Which statement best describes your work authorization?
options: Yes, I am authorized to work for my present employer only
I require sponsorship now or in the future
No, I am not authorized to work in the United States
spec_quote: A "Yes, with restrictions" / "authorized for my present employer only" / "I require sponsorship" statement is picked only when no plain or unrestricted Yes statement is offered.
why: The spec says the restricted/sponsorship statements are picked when no plain or unrestricted Yes is offered, but does not say which of these two non-preferred statements (present-employer-only vs. require-sponsorship) wins when both are present.

name: near_miss_no_sponsorship_claim_in_yes
label: Please select the statement that applies to you:
options: Yes, I am authorized to work for any employer in the United States and will not now or in the future require sponsorship
Yes, I am authorized to work for any employer in the United States
No, I am not authorized to work in the United States
expect: Yes, I am authorized to work for any employer in the United States
spec_quote: A Yes option that claims U.S. citizenship, permanent residence, a green card, permanent authorization, or that he does not need / will not need sponsorship is never picked.

name: near_miss_permanent_yes_only
label: Do you have the legal right to work in the United States?
options: Yes, I am permanently authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.
No, I am not authorized to work in the United States
spec_quote: A Yes option that claims ... permanent authorization ... is never picked. / A statement that he is NOT authorized is never picked.
why: Every offered option is forbidden: the only Yes claims permanent authorization (rule 3) and the other option says he is not authorized (rule 2). The spec gives no fallback for this situation.

name: permanently_authorized_yn
label: Are you permanently authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.?

name: permanently_authorized_longform_yn

name: citizen_pr_greencard_yn

name: status_list_icims_f1
label: What is your current immigration / visa status?
spec_quote: "What is your current immigration / visa status?" → F-1 (the option "F-1" when offered).

name: status_list_workday_f1_student_visa
label: Please select your current work authorization / immigration status:
spec_quote: "What is your current immigration / visa status?" → F-1 (the option "F-1" when offered).
why: The spec only names the exact option text "F-1"; it does not say whether a longer variant such as "F-1 Student Visa" is treated as the same offered option.
